market.note: Net of buying and selling, ₹ crore. NSE's provisional figures.

method.accumulation: Per stock: delivered share over 5 sessions against the 20 before (up to 45), sessions closed up on above-usual volume (up to 40), and net buying in bulk and block deals over 30 days (plus or minus 15).
method.breadth: The share of the sector's stocks above their own 50-day average.
method.fpi: FPI equity net investment per fortnight, as a share of the sector's assets under custody. Ranked among the scored sectors on the last three fortnights together, the latest, and the change from the one before.
method.rrg: Relative strength is the sector over the Nifty 50. RS-ratio is its 10-session average over its 50-session average; RS-momentum is that ratio over its own 20-session average. Read at each week's last session; 100 is in line. An RRG-style chart, not the licensed formula.
method.rs: The sector index's return less the Nifty 50's over 21 and 63 sessions, and its quadrant on the rotation chart.
method.score: Sector Money Flow Score, 0 to 100: FPI flow, rotation against the Nifty 50, and breadth. A part that cannot be measured is left out and the rest re-weighted.
